name: High-vol fear capitulation reversion (vol-regime fear-greed)
rationale: THESIS: extreme-fear sentiment only marks a tradable bottom when realized vol confirms it is a CAPITULATION (forced, violent selling) rather than a slow grind of resignation. Fear-greed alone fires in long calm bleeds where 'fear' just means apathy and there is no snap-back. We buy when fear_greed is below a fitted extreme-fear floor (BOUNDED) ARMED by realized vol above a fitted high-vol floor (BOUNDED) — fear PLUS violence equals capitulation. DISCONFIRMER: run the IDENTICAL fear_greed<floor rule with the vol_realized>floor gate REMOVED (bare extreme-fear contrarian). If high-vol-armed is not better risk-adjusted net of fees, the vol confirmation is decorative and this is plain sentiment contrarianism. Cross-check the low-vol-armed variant underperforms.
catalyst: Fear-greed prints extreme fear while realized vol is elevated — a violent capitulation flush, not a calm apathetic bleed.
